name: @causeway-services/shop
description: Deployable Cloudflare Worker for shop.561.group, the 561 Group's storefront for people: the books a person buys and reads, reader accounts through Google sign-in, a library per reader, and gifts. Composes @red-cup-engineering/digital-goods-storefront-services-section (TUFTE storefront, checkout, delivery, accounts, gifts); catalog.json is the catalog and scripts/compile-catalog.mjs fills each book's facts from its records.

scripts.check: node --check src/worker.mjs && node --check src/fulfillment.mjs && node --check scripts/compile-catalog.mjs && node --check scripts/arm-checkout.mjs && node --check scripts/arm-gift-agent.mjs
